page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-48 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance featuring 48 dedicated vCPUs built on the arm64 CPU architecture. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include integrated local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage.

Operating on an arm64 architecture, this instance family is designed to offer high resource density and power efficiency compared to traditional x86 alternatives. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. However, the lack of local NVMe storage and complimentary public IPv4 addresses represents a tradeoff, requiring additional network and storage configuration.

The balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance configuration appropriate for general-purpose workloads. Suitable use cases include web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and medium-scale database deployments that do not require local SSD performance or specialized hardware acceleration.
